hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"MANDATORY: graphify-out/graph.json exists. You MUST run `graphify query \"<question>\"` before grepping raw files. Only grep after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines."}}'   || true ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys,re;c=str(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command','')).replace(chr(92),'/');E=('.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.mjs','.cjs','.kt','.kts','.sql');V=('cat','head','tail','sed','awk','nl','less','more');h=any((seg.strip().lstrip('(').split()[:1] or [''])[0].lower() in V and any(e in seg.lower() for e in E) and 'graphify-out/' not in seg.lower() for seg in re.split(r'[|;&]',c));sys.stdout.write('1' if h else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Leyendo CODIGO por Bash (cat/head/sed sobre .ts/.kt/.sql): esquiva Serena y vuelca el fichero entero. TS/Kotlin -> mcp__serena__find_symbol / get_symbols_overview (solo el simbolo). SQL -> graphify. cat/sed sobre codigo solo para TRANSFORMAR, no para leer."}}'; fi || true

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in s and any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"MANDATORY: graphify-out/graph.json exists. You MUST run graphify before reading source files. Use: `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph), `graphify explain \"<concept>\"`, or `graphify path \"<A>\" \"<B>\"`. Only read raw files after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines. This rule applies to subagents too — include it in every subagent prompt involving code exploration."}}'; fi || true

OUT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys,os;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);p=str(t.get('file_path') or '').replace(chr(92),'/');pl=p.lower();E=('.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.mjs','.cjs','.kt','.kts');ok=('graphify-out/' not in pl) and any(pl.endswith(e) for e in E);s=''.join(ch for ch in str(d.get('session_id','x')) if ch.isalnum());f='/tmp/recre-reads-'+s;L=(open(f).read().splitlines() if os.path.exists(f) else []) if ok else [];n=L.count(p);ok and open(f,'a').write(p+chr(10));sys.stdout.write('1' if (ok and n==1) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$OUT" = 1 ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"RE-LECTURA: ya abriste este fichero en la sesion. En vez de releerlo entero, trae solo el simbolo con mcp__serena__find_symbol / get_symbols_overview. Releelo completo solo si vas a editarlo."}}'; fi || true
